note.zh-TW: 老師自訂的說法。教材只用文字說明、沒有公式；這一點尚未向老師提出，網站的補充定義標「網站補充定義」，不計分。
note.en: A teacher-defined term. The course describes it in words without a formula; the point has not yet been raised with the teacher, so the site's supplementary definition is labelled as such and not scored.

definition.zh-TW: 行銷投入帶動營業收入成長的效果。網站的補充定義需要兩期資料，單期時顯示 N/A。
definition.en: The effect of marketing spending on revenue growth. The site's supplementary definition needs two periods of data and shows N/A for a single period.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
